question: The feature of Quasi Federal Government system in the Constitution of India is borrowed from the constitution of which country?
solution:
The correct answer is **Canada** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constitution of India is a **federal constitution,** but it also has some unitary features.
 
• This feature is known as a **Quasi Federal Government system.**
 
• The Constitution of the United States of America is the** oldest written** national constitution still in use.
 
• It was adopted on **September 17, 1787.**
 
• The United States of America is a** federal republic**, with power divided between the federal government and the states.
 
• This division of powers is** similar **to the system in India.
 
• The United States of America also has a written Constitution, with a** Bill of Rights** that protects individual rights and freedoms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **United Kingdom** is a unitary state, with power concentrated in the** central government**.

 
 
• The UK **does not** have a written constitution, and its system of government is based on **parliamentary sovereignty.**
 
 
 
• **Canada** 
 
 
• The **Canadian Constitution Act of 1867** established the federal system of government in Canada.
 
 
 
• **South Africa** is a** unitary state**, with power concentrated in the central government.
 
 
• The Constitution of South Africa was adopted in **1996**, and it established a federal system of government with power divided between the national government and the provinces.
